$comment: AIforE's estimated split of each provider's compute across facilities (DCI spec v0.1, Phase 1 prototype). Every weight is estimated and needs board sign-off of the allocation method before any footprint built from it is published (docs/TODO.md). Facilities are found in the Data Center Resource Ledger by search until their ledger IDs are pinned here as facility_id.

components.label: AWS Project Rainier, New Carlisle, Indiana
components.rationale: Anthropic's largest disclosed training campus (Amazon Project Rainier); weighted as the single biggest share of known compute.

components.label: Colossus 1, Memphis, Tennessee (300 MW, sole tenant since May 2026)
components.rationale: Reported compute deal making Anthropic the sole tenant of Colossus 1 from May 2026; weighted by its 300 MW against Anthropic's other known capacity.

components.label: Project Rainier, Mississippi and Pennsylvania sites
components.rationale: Further Project Rainier sites reported for Anthropic; smaller and less certain than New Carlisle.

components.label: TeraWulf Lake Mariner, Barker, New York (42 MW)
components.rationale: Small reported capacity (42 MW) relative to Anthropic's other sites.

components.label: Undisclosed cloud (Google TPU regions, other AWS, Azure)
components.rationale: Anthropic also runs on Google Cloud TPUs and other AWS and Azure regions whose locations aren't disclosed; kept on the national grid so the gap stays visible.

components.label: Stargate Abilene, Texas (about 0.3 GW live)
components.rationale: OpenAI's only placed site with live capacity reported (about 0.3 GW); the rest of its compute is rented in undisclosed regions.

components.label: Undisclosed cloud (Azure, Oracle, CoreWeave, Google regions)
components.rationale: Most OpenAI inference runs in Azure, Oracle, CoreWeave and Google regions whose locations aren't disclosed; kept on the national grid so the gap stays visible.
